title: plan
description: The product owner's proposal: a short brief plus the beads to create. An empty beads list means "nothing to add right now".

type.description: Omit this. The orchestrator stamps it when it stores the message.

brief.description: One paragraph on what this plan achieves and why.

beads.description: The proposed beads, most important first.

key.description: Plan-local identifier: no whitespace, unique within the plan.

description.description: What to do, in enough detail for an engineer who has not read this plan.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria the testers hold the engineer to. Never empty.

priority.description: 0 is the most urgent, 4 the least; omit for the default 2.

size.description: Effort estimate: s under an hour, m one to three hours, l three to eight hours.

timeout.description: Only when one agent session on this bead will genuinely need longer than the run's default limit: a Go duration such as "10h". The run caps it at limits.max_agent_timeout. Omit it otherwise.

deps.description: Keys of the beads in this plan that must land first. Never a cycle, never this bead's own key.
